description:
Create a topologically colored political map of the world where no two adjacent countries share the same color.

1. Open QGIS.
2. Load the world countries shapefile from `/home/ga/GIS_Data/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp`.
3. Open the Processing Toolbox (Processing > Toolbox) and search for 'Topological coloring'.
4. Run the **Topological coloring** algorithm on the countries layer. Set the minimum number of colors to 4. This will create a new layer with a 'color_id' field.
5. Export the resulting colored layer as GeoJSON to `/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/world_colored.geojson`.
6. Apply a 'Categorized' symbology to the colored layer in QGIS: Double-click the layer, go to Symbology, choose 'Categorized', set Value to 'color_id', select a color ramp, and click Classify.
7. Save the project as `world_map_colored.qgz` in `/home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/`.
